name: skillspector
source_review: Reviewed upstream pyproject build metadata/dependencies, entrypoint, initialization and CLI no-llm path before original temporary install. Persistent install uses same exact source revision and previously tested dependency versions. No optional MCP server or developer extras installed. This is a scoped bootstrap/source review, not full-source security certification.
installation: uv tool install from exact Git revision; user tool environment and executable under ~/.local; no /tmp dependency for scanner runtime
required_runtime: Python >=3.12,<3.15; static local scans need no model API credentials. Keep --no-llm; optional dependency vulnerability lookups can query OSV.
